newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile sells 11.7 mln lbs nickel.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile sells 11.7 mln lbs nickel.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said Friday it sold about 11.7 million lbs of surplus nickel to three firms at a provisional value of nearly $38.5 million under a long-term sales agreement.
The awards went to Minor Metals Inc of Fort Lee, N.J., RMT Metals of London, England and Considar Inc of New York, N.Y., DNSC said.
It said the next bid offering for surplus nickel will be held October 10.
